prompt: a castle on that hill in the distance
cmd: npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" "A castle for the far hill. Finding one that fits this world" && npm run -s nc -- search "low poly castle" --max-faces 60000 --count 6 --run "$R" && npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" "A classic stone castle with blue roofs and flags, about 22 m tall" && npm run -s nc -- make "stone castle" --id castle --kind building --height 22 --from sketchfab:827e3eae661c48419d2616e2d7739952 --at=-49,-49 --force --run "$R" && sleep 3 && npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" --done "A stone castle now stands on the far hill" --focus castle

prompt: make the red dragon circle above the castle
cmd: npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" "Moving the dragon's flight path over the castle, higher and a bit bigger" && node scripts/demo/apply.mjs dragon && sleep 3 && npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" --done "The dragon now circles 30 m above the castle" --focus red-dragon

prompt: turn it into a golden sunset
cmd: npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" "Lowering the sun and warming the light" && node scripts/demo/apply.mjs sunset && sleep 4 && npm run -s nc -- log --run "$R" --done "Golden hour, with long shadows across the valley" --focus castle
